title: Voice language pack manifest
description: One installable language pack (master plan 13, 16.3): the speech models for one language and the exact files that make them, one YAML file per pack in models/voice-packs/. Every model file carries a pinned size and sha256, so there is no unverified-but-allowed file. Quality scores and resource needs are present in every manifest and are explicit nulls until M4-06 measures them. The file is embedded in the binary (models/voice-packs), which ties the pins to the release; internal/voice/packs installs only manifests that came from that embedded set. The schema is self-contained.

id.description: Pack id and file name stem (<id>.yaml). Lower case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter (en, it, it-fast).

version.description: The pack's own version label. The exact bytes are identified by each file's revision and sha256.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag the pack serves.

status.description: Qualification state, the same lifecycle as the model registry. candidate: named by ADR 0015, not measured. qualified-emulated: measured in a resource-limited container, never a certification. certified: measured on real hardware. An operator may install a candidate, but only after explicitly approving it.

models.description: The models, keyed by voice role. A pack may provide any non-empty subset: an STT-only pack is valid and leaves output on text.

quality.description: Quality scores, measured by M4-06 on licence-clean audio. Null until measured.

measurement.description: Where the numbers above come from; null until measured.

resources.description: What the pack needs while it is the active pack. Null until measured, except disk, which is the sum of the file sizes and is checked against them.

engine.description: The runtime backend that loads the files (whisper.cpp, piper, silero-vad). The engine is a separate process and is not part of the pack.

registry_id.description: The model registry entry (models/registry/<id>.yaml) this model is qualified under, or null while the registry has none. A non-null id must resolve and its pinned hash must equal the file's.

name.description: File name in the pack directory. A bare name: no separators, no leading dot.

url.description: Where the operator fetches the pinned file. AlixAI never fetches it: install copies from a directory the operator provides.

revision.description: Upstream git commit the file was pinned at.

licence.description: Recorded, not resolved: the final redistribution sign-off is the M5-H02 human licence review.
